landing.seoTitle: VetoCrm — Veterinary CRM for clinics and practices

landing.demoCopy: Guided tour in the real app on Clinic Demo data — read-only. Records, documents, certificates and key modules, with no sign-up and no risk of changing data.
landing.journeyTitle: In three steps, your clinic is ready
landing.journeyCopy: A simple flow: create the workspace, invite the team, care for patients. No friction, no spreadsheets.
landing.step1Body: Pick a plan, sign up in minutes. Your organization and quotas are ready immediately.
landing.step2Body: Admins and assistants join with a code. Clear permissions, data isolated per clinic.
landing.step3Body: Appointments, consultations, vaccines, antiparasitics, inventory, and farms — all synced, everywhere.
landing.capabilitiesCopy: Built for real practice: companion animals, livestock, and the pace of a true clinic.
landing.featClientsBody: Full profiles, medical history, photos, and household follow-up.
landing.featAgendaBody: Appointments, reminders, and a clear view of the clinic day.
landing.featConsultBody: Structured clinical notes, prescriptions, and printable documents.
landing.featVaxBody: Protocols, due dates, and certificates — without losing track.
landing.featStockBody: Inventory, alerts, and financial tracking based on your plan.
landing.featSecurityBody: Data isolated by organization, with controlled roles and access.
landing.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about veterinary CRM

faq.a: VetoCrm is a CRM / practice management system for veterinary clinics: clients, patients, appointments, consultations, vaccines, antiparasitics, inventory, and farms.

faq.q: Is VetoCrm suitable for a solo practice?
faq.a: Yes. A free starter plan lets you begin alone, then upgrade to multi-user plans as the team grows.
Yes. The multi-organization architecture isolates data per clinic, with admin and assistant roles.

faq.q: Can I manage vaccines and antiparasitics?
faq.a: Yes. Protocols, due dates, certificates, and history are built into the patient record.
